title: Directly traverse overlapping SSTables in Fusion last
rationale: FusionTransaction::last first collected overlapping SSTables into a temporary Vec, cloning each Arc<SsTable>, and then iterated that list. The SSTable list is already snapshotted before the loop, so overlap checks can skip non-matching SSTables and process matching ones directly.
steps: Invert the overlap predicate into a continue guard
Process overlapping SSTables directly from the sstables snapshot
Run Fusion storage and SQL MIN/MAX regressions
expected_impact: Avoids per-call temporary SSTable list allocation and Arc cloning in last()/MAX range queries.
